verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents native function calling inside the Voice Agent API. The model emits an action and its parameters during a live conversation, and the developer's application executes it. The no-dead-air part of the story is not evidenced: InjectAgentMessage can make the agent speak a line mid-call, but it is not documented as filler while a function runs. missing for 10: documented latency or filler handling during function execution, explicit docs on speaking function results back, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can call external APIs and custom functions mid-conversation and speak the result without awkward dead air

citations.quote: function calling enables your agent to perform tasks during a live conversation
Function calling bridges this gap by allowing the model to describe an action and its required parameters, which your application then executes.
Inject agent message | Mid-call | InjectAgentMessage | Makes the agent speak a specific line
